resolution.note: backlog triage 2026-11-07: Improves retired delivery ceremony (briefs/review/verify/slice/deliver/worker/red-first/hardening checklist)

title: Make krn-lead review fixes fast-forward commits
body:
Evidence: PR #151 (2026-10-31): the auto-mode classifier refused --force-with-lease on the lead's own branch (second time after #150), so squash-after-push (krn-lead steps 6 and 9) stalled; a fast-forward fix commit after the tracker close delivered with an identical merge.
Acceptance: krn-lead step 6/9 says review fixes land as fast-forward commits with their own Change-contract and never require rewriting pushed history; test/rules/project-skills.test.ts pins the wording.
